title: Concept: Synchronous OS command execution in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, child_process.execSync is called. The function passes its string to /bin/sh, so a value controlled by a request can inject `;`, `&&`, backticks or `$()` and run additional commands with the application identity. The synchronous form is often chosen in scripts and build steps where review attention is low.
applicability: javascript tooling and services that shell out to system commands.
risk: Arbitrary command execution with application privileges; HIGH severity.
